description: An Advanced CNC Programmer designs, develops, and optimizes complex CNC programs for various tool room machines, ensuring the precise manufacture of parts according to advanced specifications. This role involves in-depth knowledge of machining processes, CAD/CAM software, quality control, and production planning. Upon successful completion, learners will be qualified for advanced programming roles in engineering, manufacturing, machine tools, and automobile industries, enabling them to lead complex machining projects and contribute to strategic production goals.
